signal: Revalize launched a new partner program for CAD, CPQ, and PLM and published its Smart Manufacturing 2026 research on the AI skills gap

email.body1:
Susan, saw Revalize launched its CAD, CPQ, and PLM partner program and published the Smart Manufacturing 2026 report.

A new partner channel usually opens more in-market manufacturer accounts than the team can cover before they cool, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Revalize off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Susan, quick follow-up for Revalize.

With a new partner channel feeding leads, the pipeline target climbs faster than reps can ramp. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Revalize needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Susan, last bit of proof for Revalize.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Revalize's reply rate likely compares to other manufacturing-software vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Susan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most as a new partner program ramps, and I know running a multi-product GTM motion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a manufacturing-software motion? I will tailor it to Revalize either way.
